recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間有一個邊界略疏鬆、非貼骨小樑（non-paratrabecular）的小淋巴球聚集，周圍仍保有三系造血與巨核細胞；需搭配免疫染色才能判定是 rituximab 後的 T 細胞增生。
features: Hypercellular-appearing marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis between bony trabeculae
Single non-paratrabecular (interstitial) aggregate of small lymphocytes with somewhat loose, infiltrative borders
Aggregate cells are small with round dark nuclei; no germinal center
Megakaryocytes present in normal numbers with normal-appearing morphology
Small dark cluster at upper right, likely an erythroid island or crush artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows trabecular bone and cellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes. A single interstitial, non-paratrabecular lymphoid aggregate composed of small lymphocytes with slightly ill-defined borders is present; no germinal center or paratrabecular extension is seen. H&E morphology alone cannot determine the lineage of the aggregate. In a patient treated with rituximab, immunostains showing a predominance of CD3+ T cells with absent CD20+ B cells would support rituximab-associated reactive T-cell aggregates rather than residual B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Rituximab can mask CD20, so PAX5, CD79a or CD19 staining is needed; residual lymphoma is B-cell rich and light-chain restricted, whereas reactive aggregates are T-cell predominant.
FL typically forms paratrabecular aggregates of CD10+/BCL2+ B cells.
Ordinary benign aggregates are small, well circumscribed, often contain vessels and have a mixed B/T population, without a rituximab history.
PTCL shows cytologic atypia, loss of pan-T antigens and clonal TCR rearrangement, unlike the small bland T cells of reactive hyperplasia.
